reception: The citation record is thin and uniformly brief. The paper appears in passing, mostly in the related work of later efforts in the same line — Pearl's reinforcement-learning code optimization, cost models supporting dynamic program sizes, a reinforcement-learning environment for the MLIR compiler, CHEHAB's homomorphic-encryption optimization — and in a survey of lightweight deep learning, as one instance of a learned compiler heuristic. No citing work engages the model in depth; its reception is as an entry in the catalogue of neural approaches to loop optimization.
